state.units: Dimensionless model coordinates; no SI scale or physical seconds are specified by canonical source. One transition is one model step.
state.nondimensional_note: p/v labels describe oscillator coordinates; spring and fluid description is an interpretation of the fixed discrete linear plant, not an SI-calibrated mechanical simulation.

observation.precision: Rounded observation only; internal transition and reward use exact carried float64 state. Float32 observation aliasing remains; time augmentation addresses hidden horizon, not quantization.
observation.world: stall or no_stall is fixed by construction; different worlds are different configured tasks; no world bit is included.

action.input_policy: Exact shape (4,), finite real numeric values; booleans, strings, complex values and malformed shapes rejected. Cast float32 then float64 then clip [-1,1], as canonical Env. Values becoming nonfinite in float32 are rejected.
action.low_level_dynamics: Canonical dynamics itself casts float64 and clips; callers needing environment parity must quantize the command to float32 first.

dynamics.B1: B1[2*k+1,k]=B1[2*(k+1)+1,k]=1 for k=0..3; other entries zero
dynamics.A10_provenance: Exact Stage0 export: radii .98-.96, angles [.10,.20,.35,.55,.80], Gaussian coupling norm .02 seed20261011 attempt0. Frozen matrix avoids BLAS-dependent regeneration.

controllability.model: Canonical x_next=A*x+B*u with effective thrust u; same matrices in stall and no-stall worlds.
controllability.exogenous_behavior: Current is constant; waves rotate by 0.27 radians per model step with constant amplitude in exact arithmetic. Commands cannot stop, set, or damp these coordinates.
controllability.rank_method: SVD, NumPy default sigma_max*max(matrix.shape)*eps(float64) and each stated absolute tolerance.
controllability.limits: Linear rank does not establish global reachability under bounded, stalled, float32 commands. Remaining time is observed, not actuated.

dynamics.noise: None in transition or reward; randomness only in reset.
dynamics.arithmetic: Original fixed-column float64 sums; batch and scalar operations have same order.
dynamics.reward_time: Pre-transition state and clipped command; energy uses command, including stalled magnitude.

reset.options: Exactly one of state[13] or start law overrides; neither means default law. Unknown options rejected. Start overrides current(lo,hi),wave(lo,hi),kick >=0, all finite.
reset.gaussian_tail: Gaussian starts are unbounded mathematically; a draw outside validity set raises, with no rejection sampling or silent clipping.
reset.rng: Gymnasium per-instance np_random; seed resets it; seed=None continues it; explicit state does not draw. action_space.seed is independent.

finite_horizon.reason: The 100-step endpoint is intrinsic to this benchmark task and remaining time is observed.

continuing_time_limit.reason: Explicit legacy replay of a continuing task collected in 100-step segments; do not mix objective labels with finite_horizon.

step.legacy_observation_mode: physical (13 coordinates) available only with continuing_time_limit

validation.physical_state_parity: Exact binary equality required for saved NumPy fixtures; browser cross-language validation may use declared float64 tolerance.
validation.source_identity: Byte-identical original source files authenticated at import; frozen full matrices hash checked.
validation.observation_bound: Canonical contraction/input bound <300 from allowed starts; adapter checks declared space on every reset/step.
validation.environment_checker: Gymnasium check_env included in unittest suite.

reference_capabilities.deterministic_policy_rollout: Physical transitions permit float64 finite-horizon rollouts under an explicitly specified policy.
reference_capabilities.globally_optimal_controller: Not claimed by the environment adapter; capped linear feedback is only a baseline unless a separate certificate is provided.
reference_capabilities.policy_value: Must use same world, command quantization, gamma .98, time and horizon; finite task terminal continuation is zero.
reference_capabilities.historical_studies: Historical continuous diagnostics used obs15=[physical13,regime,time] and default gamma1; models/returns require explicit audited adaptation, never interchangeable.

wrapper_changes: explicit finite_horizon versus continuing_time_limit flags and masks
frozen Stage0 matrix bridge replacing repository-only imports

information_access.learner_default: public observations, actions, rewards and boundary fields from declared training split
information_access.restriction: No diagnostic fields as actor inputs or additional model features in the observation-only benchmark. Exact-state learning requires a separately declared information tier.
information_access.identified_model_baseline: Fits first13 public float32 observation coordinates; no exact info states.
